purpose: Earn one cross-campaign measurement basis before any portfolio ranking.

metric.atom_credit: 1 iff a frozen parent-residual atom is moved by independent-or-stronger evidence to a terminal state or a strictly more specific typed child residual with protected invariants preserved; otherwise 0
metric.cost_rule: completed_at - started_at for the single declared qualification job; include setup/build/fetch/verification overhead
prohibitions: no credit for label changes without an executable narrower next action
no credit if protected invariants regress

campaigns.verification_boundary: full frozen 193-case reclosure; no ACCEPT/REJECT regression; each credited atom must have an observed neutral-head witness and one child class

campaigns.fresh_source_selection_rule: lexicographically first *_ex.pvs with a matching .prf at pinned pvs_cad commit, excluding all previously used cad_demo/cad_examples/cad_star_ex/cad_examples3/cad_examples4 families
campaigns.atom_definition: each top-level LEMMA occurrence in the frozen fresh PVS theory
campaigns.verification_boundary: frozen V5 exact recognizer + frozen five consequence routes; source proof presence pinned; any routed adapter Lean-kernel checked; unsupported formulas remain typed UNKNOWN

portfolio_rule_after_measurement: Only if both campaign results satisfy this exact shared basis may their measured utilities be compared. Otherwise remain HOLD_INCOMPARABLE.
